articles.title: NATO Pledges a Whopping 70 Billion Euros to Help Ukraine
articles.summary: At a summit in Turkey, NATO countries promised 70 billion euros in military aid to Ukraine. President Trump said the U.S. will even show Ukraine how to build Patriot missiles. Ukraine's leader Zelenskyy thanked everyone.

articles.title: A Giant Arch in D.C.? How a Secret Club Pushed It Through
articles.summary: President Trump wants a 250-foot-tall arch near the Lincoln Memorial. But the design came from a tiny group of his friends, not a public contest. Some experts say the fast approval broke rules that have been around for over 100 years.

articles.title: Trump's Name Is Off the Kennedy Center—and a Court Says It Stays Off
articles.summary: A court told President Trump he can't stop workers from removing his name from the Kennedy Center in D.C. The name is already gone, and judges said Trump didn't prove it would really hurt the center.
